lines.name: CARD
lines.text: The Biscayne Classic. 212 players. One trophy.

lines.name: GNOMEY
lines.text: Two hundred and twelve runners. Final table by the cage. Good luck, all.

lines.name: MUSTICH
lines.subject: mustich
lines.text: Your table or mine, I'll see you at the end of it.

lines.name: TOMMY
lines.subject: tommy
lines.text: Thirty years I've chased that trophy. Don't let a kid with a solver take it home.
